description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It provides a simple launcher interface that displays a grid of sample activities, allowing users to select and launch each sample. The class manages a list of samples, sets up a GridView with a custom adapter, and handles item click events to start corresponding activities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that serves as the main launcher for a sample app, displaying a grid of sample options.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: A data class representing a sample item with title, description, and the intent to launch the corresponding activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, prepares the list of sample activities, and configures the GridView.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the grid items; launches the selected sample activity.
